n: The Neural Bridge: haptic cords to Python (TU Wien)
t: A research paper on acting out neural networks with cords, then coding them in Python.
steps: Find the paper Turning Students into Neurons from TU Wien.
Read how the activity is set up.
Look for the related ITiCSE 2026 paper by Ritter, Lehner, and others.
Gather cords and carabiners as the paper suggests.
Draft a short lesson with a teacher colleague.
Test the physical activity with a small group.
Prepare a simple Python example if the class will code.
